cluster.content:
The county pension fund is seeking a single manager of managers to oversee portfolios across domestic equity, international equity, and fixed income.

Key limits for the search:
- Maximum mandate size: up to $350 million.
- Firm-level AUM limit for responders: less than $30 billion.

Relevant supporting details from the RFP:
- The search “contemplates investments of up to $350 million” with a qualified manager of managers.
- The Fund “expects to select one manager to fulfill this mandate.”
- Under minimum qualifications, “The Responder must have less than $30 Billion in assets under management at the firm level.”

Additional related point:
- The RFP also says it is preferred that the responder select underlying managers with no more than $10 billion in AUM, but that preference applies to the underlying managers, not to the responding firm itself.
